最多 {{count}} 个令牌，先撤销一个不用的: At most {{count}} tokens; revoke one you no longer use first

已撤销：用它的 AI 下一次调用会被拒绝。: Revoked: the AI using it is refused on its next call.
让 Claude Code、Codex 等通过 MCP 读今天的安排、回答待决事: Let Claude Code, Codex and others read today's schedule, answer pending decisions, note something down and record work done, over MCP. 用它的 AI 叫什么；它的每次写入都会标上这个名字: What the AI using it is called; each of its writes is marked with this name
可以读，也可以记下一件事、回答待决事项、记录完成: Can read, note something down, answer pending decisions and record work done
只能读：今天的安排、待决事项和任务: Read only: today's schedule, pending decisions and tasks
